name: io.github.gmcho2009-cloud/wenjia-home-fix
title: Wenjia Home-Fix Diagnosis
description: Chinese home repair self-diagnosis engine: 40 categories, 200 symptom decision trees. Returns clarifying questions, causes ranked by prior probability, step-by-step fixes ordered by safety, parts prices, and when to call a professional. Read-only, no auth. Includes atomic tools prob_distribution / price_band / stop_check for agent-to-agent calls. Data CC BY 4.0.
